G0_provenance.metric: 60 episodes / 35917 frames / 30 FPS; original 9D state; source hashes recorded
G0_provenance.threshold: dataset, episode count, schema, source and MASTER/NOMASTER status confirmed

G1_signal_availability.metric: 35917/35917 finite rows for pos/load/current/action; current has 18 unique values and 30.9% global-extreme rows
G1_signal_availability.threshold: signals exist per frame, ordered, without large missing/nonfinite regions
G1_signal_availability.anomaly: current is heavily quantized and dominated by zero

G2_phase_recoverability.metric: five coarse phases recovered for all 60 episodes from 60/60 human-reviewed boundaries
G2_phase_recoverability.threshold: major phases recoverable; complete automatic S0-S6 separation not required

G3_single_episode_structure.metric: representative episode 13 plotted with pos/load/current/action and coarse phases
G3_single_episode_structure.threshold: at least one representative episode timeline

G4_cross_episode_consistency.metric: load closing delta +92 and release delta -110 with 60/60 episode sign consistency; stable/hold load-current overlap is high
G4_cross_episode_consistency.threshold: compare phase distributions and cross-episode trend consistency
G4_cross_episode_consistency.anomaly: force-related separation is transition-specific, not stable-hold-specific

G5_temporal_separability.metric: stable-grasp load: single d=-0.028/overlap=0.650 vs 15-frame max d=-1.492/overlap=0.367; current remains weak
G5_temporal_separability.anomaly: lift/place tail mixes suspended hold, support regain and pre-release transition

G6_hold_action_quality.metric: median action range 5.27 deg; median reopening 4.11 deg; 15/60 episodes reopen >=5 deg
G6_hold_action_quality.threshold: hold/lift command stability, variation and systematic reopening reported; 5 deg is descriptive, not a frozen PASS threshold
G6_hold_action_quality.anomaly: expert command itself gradually reopens during combined lift/place

falsification.F1: PARTIAL_TRIGGER: stable-grasp and lift/place absolute load/current distributions overlap heavily
falsification.F2: TRIGGERED_FOR_STABLE_STATE: gripper.pos separates open/closed strongly while load/current add little stable-state information
falsification.F3: NOT_TRIGGERED_FOR_TRANSITIONS: closing/release load sign is repeatable across all 60 episodes
falsification.F4: PARTIAL_TRIGGER: expert action reopens >=5 deg in 25% of lift/place intervals and median reopening is 4.11 deg
falsification.F5: PARTIAL_TRIGGER_CURRENT: current is quantized with many zeros; load has no large global saturation
